CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.course_entry_review_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status in ('rejected', 'more_evidence', 'returned_layer2', 'returned_layer3', 'superseded') then
    perform security.course_entry_review_apply_v1(new.id, new.status, null, 'Layer 4 ' || new.status);
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.entry_matrix_review_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.status in ('rejected', 'more_evidence', 'returned_layer2', 'returned_layer3', 'superseded') then
    perform security.entry_matrix_review_apply_v1(new.id, new.status, null, 'Layer 4 ' || new.status);
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.field_enrich_items_absence_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.course_id is null or new.state is not distinct from old.state then return null; end if;
  if new.state in ('filled', 'review', 'skipped', 'failed') then perform security.field_absence_classify_v1(new.id); end if;
  return null;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.field_enrich_items_gate_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
  if new.course_id is null then return new; end if;
  -- held, or tried on the same input less than gaps.recheck_days ago: not queued (CF-247 21 Oct 2026: the hold is security.enrich_item_held_v1)
  if security.enrich_item_held_v1(new.course_id, new.field) then return null; end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.layer4_evidence_link_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
-- Trigger layer4_review_items_zz_evidence (BEFORE INSERT): a new waiting item of a kind in layer4.evidence_link_kinds that arrives without a
-- stored copy gets the newest stored copy of its page. No read is made; nothing else changes.
begin
  if new.evidence_id is null and new.status = 'pending' and security.pipeline_num_v1('layer4.evidence_link_on', 1) >= 1
     and new.field_code = any (security.pipeline_list_v1('layer4.evidence_link_kinds', '[]'::jsonb)) then
    new.evidence_id := security.layer4_stored_copy_v1(security.layer4_item_page_v1(new.field_code, new.proposed_value, new.layer2_state));
  end if;
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.layer4_return_layer3_requeue_trg()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'security', 'pipeline'
AS $function$
declare v_item pipeline.layer4_review_items%rowtype;
begin
  if new.action<>'return_layer3' then return new; end if;
  select * into v_item from pipeline.layer4_review_items where id=new.review_item_id;
  if v_item.field_code<>'provider_current_tuition_validation' or v_item.layer3_interpretation_id is null then return new; end if;
  update pipeline.layer3_work_items w
  set status='pending', available_at=now(), completed_at=null, reserved_at=null, reserved_by=null,
      last_error='Returned by a Layer 4 reviewer for another AI check',
      corrective_retry_reason=left('Layer 4 send-back: '||coalesce(new.reason,''),2000),
      corrective_retry_count=w.corrective_retry_count + case when w.attempt_count>=5 then 1 else 0 end,
      corrective_retry_authorized_at=case when w.attempt_count>=5 then now() else w.corrective_retry_authorized_at end,
      updated_at=now()
  where w.interpretation_id=v_item.layer3_interpretation_id and w.status in ('layer4_required','parked','no_candidate','rejected');
  return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.no_page_review_trg_v1()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.coverage_identity_allowed(p_provider_id uuid, p_basis text, p_attr text)

 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER

AS $function$
  select case when p_basis in ('cricos_code', 'cricos_code_on_page', 'cricos_search') and not exists (select 1 from catalogue.providers p0 join ref.countries k0 on k0.id = p0.country_id where p0.id = p_provider_id and k0.iso_alpha2 = 'AU') then false -- 24 Oct 2026: a CRICOS proof exists only in Australia -- fixed: the register is Australian
            when p_basis in ('adapter_code', 'adapter_title')
                   -- 23 Oct 2026 (Platform Admin 12:40): in the countries of identity.adapter_title_countries an adapter title match counts
                   -- like an exact title for the fields its country list names, whatever the adapter admits
                   and not (p_basis = 'adapter_title' and p_attr is not null
                            and exists (select 1 from catalogue.providers p2 join ref.countries k2 on k2.id = p2.country_id
                                         where p2.id = p_provider_id and k2.iso_alpha2 in (select jsonb_array_elements_text(s.value) from pipeline.platform_toolset_settings s
                                                                                            where s.toolset_key = 'pipeline' and s.key = 'identity.adapter_title_countries')))
                   and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.uni_adapters u where u.provider_id = p_provider_id and u.enabled and u.admit and (p_attr is null or p_attr not in ('intakes', 'english', 'tuition') or (case p_attr when 'tuition' then 'fee' else p_attr end) = any (u.admit_fields))) then false
         else coalesce((
    select case when p_attr is null
                then exists (select 1 from jsonb_each(a.identities) e, jsonb_array_elements_text(e.value) b where b = p_basis)
                else coalesce(a.identities->p_attr ? p_basis, false) end

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.pdesc_similarity_v1(a text, b text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with x as (select security.pdesc_words_v1(a) wa, security.pdesc_words_v1(b) wb)
  select case when cardinality(x.wa) = 0 or cardinality(x.wb) = 0 then 0
              else round((select count(*) from unnest(x.wa) w where w = any (x.wb))::numeric
                         / (select count(*) from (select unnest(x.wa) union select unnest(x.wb)) u), 4) end
    from x

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION security.pdesc_support_v1(p_sentence text, p_quote text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  with s as (select distinct left(w, 5) w from regexp_split_to_table(lower(coalesce(p_sentence, '')), '[^a-z0-9]+') w
              where length(w) >= 4 and w not in ('that', 'this', 'with', 'from', 'into', 'their', 'there', 'which', 'where', 'what', 'have', 'also', 'such', 'they', 'them', 'than', 'more', 'most', 'other', 'offers', 'offer', 'provides', 'provide')),
       q as (select distinct left(w, 5) w from regexp_split_to_table(lower(coalesce(p_quote, '')), '[^a-z0-9]+') w where length(w) >= 4)
  select case when (select count(*) from s) = 0 then 1 else round((select count(*) from s where s.w in (select w from q))::numeric / (select count(*) from s), 4) end
$function$
